name: Visual Liturgy Live
shortDescription: A Church of England worship-planning application for Common Worship services, lectionary readings, liturgy and service-sheet preparation.
company: Church House Publishing, run for the Archbishops’ Council of the Church of England
suitableContexts: Church of England parishes preparing Common Worship services
Clergy and parish teams using lectionary readings and seasonal material
Churches producing service sheets and planning liturgy from a structured Common Worship library

pricing.summary: The Church of England’s current national-support page lists Visual Liturgy Live at £52 per year and as PC-only. The product site says that a current subscription is needed for ongoing content updates. Obtain the current licence, team-use, support, cancellation and update terms before purchase.

gdprInformation: The reviewed product material is primarily about liturgical resources and desktop planning. It does not establish modern cloud data-processing, hosting, sub-processor or DPA terms. Churches should not assume that a desktop service-planning tool needs no local data-protection assessment: establish what user, licence, support and backup data are held and where before use.

church-of-england-scope.value: Supplier describes Visual Liturgy Live as service-planning software for Church of England worship using the Common Worship library and related material.

operator.value: The Visual Liturgy project states that Church House Publishing runs it on behalf of the Archbishops’ Council of the Church of England.

pricing-and-platform.value: The Church of England’s national-support page lists an annual subscription of £52 and describes the product as PC-only and legacy.

subscription-updates.value: Supplier states that current subscribers receive content updates, including new lectionary information, and that team use requires a team subscription.

editorial.assessment: Visual Liturgy Live is a specialist Church of England liturgy and service-planning application, not a generic worship-band planner, presentation tool, people database or church-management suite. It is most relevant where Common Worship text, seasonal material and lectionary planning are central to the weekly workflow. The Church of England itself describes it as a legacy PC-only product, so a parish should test current device compatibility, team licensing, output formats and support before relying on it for live service preparation.
